info.name: Retrieves the dynamic ProductOffering by ID for USSD

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the ProductOffering

params.name: offerMenuId
params.description: This will be used by 3PP to pass the AuthKey values.

params.name: category
params.description: Category of the product to be fetched from that catalogue

params.name: subCategory
params.description: This can be any of the sub category of the category entered. This may be require only if the category is passed. Subscriber Type can be passed like Prepaid or Postpaid.

params.name: platform
params.description: This flag correlates to the allPlatforms flag in the response. In essence, its a ‘Flag’ indicating which platform the bundles is being requested for. All - Indicates that all bundles should be returned. ‘Self Service’ - Indicates the bundles are being requested for self-service platforms ‘Assisted Sales’ - Indicates the bundles are being requested for assisted sales channels CSR Only

params.name: channel
params.description: This parameter indicates which channel the response is for. like "All", "IVR", "MTNApp", "USSD", "Portal"

params.name: bundleState
params.description: When passed in input ,helps to return only the 'Active' or 'Inactive' or 'All' the bundles . Allowed values 'Active' , 'Inactive' and 'All'.

params.name: subscriberType
params.description: The subscriber type associated to the MSISDN entered above. The field can be one of the following values-Converged,Prepaid, MVNO,Contract,Hybrid,EBU,FTTH.The Neon offers will be returned irrespective of the subtye.

params.name: amount
params.description: Specify the balance amount

params.name: topSeller
params.description: When set to 'Yes' output contains both the top selling and regular bundles. When set to 'No' the output contains only the regular bundles. When set to 'All' returns both the top selling and regular bundles .Allowed values 'Yes','No','All'

params.name: purchaseMedium
params.description: When passed in input ,helps to return only the matched bundles.Suppose if user tries to buy via Airtime this parameter takes value as 'Airtime' and those applicable bundles are returned.Allowed values 'Card','Airtime','Momo','Loyalty' and 'All'.

params.name: pricePlanId
params.description: The priceplan ID associated to the MSISDN entered above. Bundles that are not applicable to this price plan are excluded from the response based on this parameter and also bundles only applicable for the price plan is returned.

params.name: suburb
params.description: Specify the suburb of the customer

params.name: city
params.description: Specify the city of the customer

params.name: province
params.description: Specify the province of the customer
